title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
hook_text: NAACP lawsuit against xAI moves forward
script:
Thirty-five gas turbines power the xAI data center in Memphis, Tennessee.
A federal judge just allowed an NAACP lawsuit against the Elon Musk company to move forward.
The civil rights organization accuses the artificial intelligence firm of violating the Clean Air Act.
Residents argue that unpermitted emissions from the facility threaten local air quality and public health.
Will this court battle force tech companies to clean up their infrastructure?
